findings.title: SQL injection in search_users via f-string query building
findings.detail: Attacker-controlled keyword is interpolated directly into the SQL LIKE clause via f-string; a payload such as '%' OR 1=1 -- escapes the clause and executes arbitrary SQL.

findings.title: Password stored in plaintext in set_password (no hashing or salting)
findings.detail: The raw new_password is written to the users table as-is; any database compromise exposes all credentials in plaintext.

findings.title: Unmarked SQL injection pattern in get_users_with_orders orders query (f-string user_id)
findings.detail: user['id'] is interpolated into an f-string-built SQL query with no parameterization; not directly attacker-controlled today, but any attacker-influenced user record would enable SQL injection (defense-in-depth violation).

findings.title: Plaintext password stored in create_user (unmarked second instance of SD-003)
findings.detail: create_user also persists the raw password without hashing at a separate, unmarked code site — the same plaintext-at-rest credential exposure class as SD-003.

findings.title: No input validation on username/email/password in create_user
findings.detail: Username and email are stored without format checks or sanitization (HTML/script payloads can be persisted, enabling stored XSS when rendered), and any password including empty is accepted, weakening credential policy.

findings.title: create_user 对 username/password/email 完全缺少输入校验
findings.detail: create_user 直接执行 INSERT，未校验 username 非空、email 格式、password 长度与复杂度，也未做 trim/归一化。

findings.title: get_average_age 对空列表求均值导致 ZeroDivisionError
findings.detail: total / len(user_ids) 在 user_ids 为空时触发 ZeroDivisionError，函数没有空输入守卫。

findings.title: get_users_with_orders 在循环内逐用户查询订单，N+1 次数据库往返
findings.detail: 对每个 user 在 for 循环内单独执行一次订单查询（N+1 模式），且内层查询同样用 f-string 拼接 SQL。

findings.title: UserService 与 OrderService 相互引用形成循环依赖
findings.detail: OrderService.__init__ 接受 UserService，UserService.set_order_service 又持有 OrderService 引用，对象图成环。

findings.title: get_average_age 未处理用户不存在或缺少 age 字段
findings.detail: user = self.db.get_user(uid) 后直接 user["age"]，未判空；真实 DB 对不存在的 id 返回 None 时会抛 TypeError。

findings.title: search_users 的 LIKE 关键字未转义通配符 % 和 _
findings.detail: keyword 直接拼入 LIKE 模式，用户输入中的 % 或 _ 会被当作通配符。
